from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)

        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):

            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_sma_200.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
        self.spy_sma_50.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close)

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_bar.Close)

        if (not self.spy_sma_200.IsReady or
                not self.spy_sma_50.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady or
                not self.spy_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_closes.IsReady):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            # "SMA(50) crosses" is implemented as SPY close crossing below SMA(50).
            previous_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            previous_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Window[1].Value
            if previous_close >= previous_sma_50 and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            previous_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            previous_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Window[1].Value
            if previous_close <= previous_sma_200 and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value:
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
            red_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
                self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
                self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )
            if red_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ParallelSlotsStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.sma(self.spy, 200, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.sma(self.spy, 50, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.rsi(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY
        )

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = None

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.set_warm_up(200, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                return
            bars[ticker] = data.bars[symbol]

        spy_close = bars["SPY"].close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].close

        spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.current.value
        spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.current.value
        aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi_14.current.value

        if self.is_warming_up:
            self._update_state(
                spy_close, aapl_close, spy_sma_200, spy_sma_50, aapl_rsi
            )
            return

        if (
            not self.spy_sma_200.is_ready
            or not self.spy_sma_50.is_ready
            or not self.aapl_rsi_14.is_ready
            or self.spy_closes.count < 2
            or self.aapl_closes.count < 4
            or self.previous_spy_close is None
            or self.previous_spy_sma_200 is None
            or self.previous_spy_sma_50 is None
            or self.previous_aapl_rsi is None
        ):
            self._update_state(
                spy_close, aapl_close, spy_sma_200, spy_sma_50, aapl_rsi
            )
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            sma_50_crosses = (
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 <= self.previous_spy_close
                and spy_sma_50 > spy_close
            ) or (
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 >= self.previous_spy_close
                and spy_sma_50 < spy_close
            )

            if sma_50_crosses:
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_rsi > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            crosses_above_sma_200 = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                and spy_close > spy_sma_200
            )

            if crosses_above_sma_200:
                shares = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) / spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
            red_for_three_days = (
                aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[0]
                and self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
                and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
            )

            if red_for_three_days and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self._update_state(
            spy_close, aapl_close, spy_sma_200, spy_sma_50, aapl_rsi
        )

    def _update_state(
        self,
        spy_close: float,
        aapl_close: float,
        spy_sma_200: float,
        spy_sma_50: float,
        aapl_rsi: float
    ):
        self.spy_closes.add(spy_close)
        self.aapl_closes.add(aapl_close)

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = spy_sma_200
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = spy_sma_50
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = aapl_rsi
